hook.name: WethFeeHookImmutable
hook.description: Charges a WETH-denominated fee (3%, 5%, or 10% based on the token's launch tier, or a global fallback rate) on every swap by intercepting the WETH leg via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Accrued fees are distributed permissionlessly among a treasury, token creator, a flagship buyback vault, and the token's on-chain reward mechanism.
